# Themyth Agency

> Shopify growth consultancy. We build Shopify growth systems that scale with control: strategic diagnostics, conversion-focused design, and scalable infrastructure for growing Shopify brands.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://themythagency.lovable.app/): Positioning, services overview, social proof.
- [About](https://themythagency.lovable.app/about): Founder story and how we work.
- [Services & Packages](https://themythagency.lovable.app/services): Fixed-price packages and a custom package builder.
- [Growth Foundations Audit](https://themythagency.lovable.app/audit): Diagnostic engagement details.
- [Portfolio](https://themythagency.lovable.app/portfolio): Selected work.
- [Case Studies](https://themythagency.lovable.app/case-studies): Outcome-led project breakdowns.
- [Blog](https://themythagency.lovable.app/blog): Shopify growth articles.
- [Contact](https://themythagency.lovable.app/contact): Lead qualification form.

## Packages
- The Launch Pad, $500: full Shopify store build from scratch.
- The Foundation, $1,000: brand, trust, on-page SEO and email foundations.
- The Growth Engine, $1,500: checkout, paid ads and conversion optimization.
- The Scale System, $2,000: international, marketplace and full-funnel scale.
- The Growth Partner, $800 per month: ongoing retainer.
- Custom Package: pick individual services, live running total.
